meal.title: Installing Code::Blocks on Windows
meal.objective: Install the Code::Blocks IDE on a Windows computer

voice.script: Want to start coding in C right now? How do you get Code::Blocks onto a Windows PC? Code::Blocks is a free, open‑source development environment for C, meaning it bundles a text editor, a compiler, and tools to manage your projects. First, open a web browser and go to codeblocks.org. Click the Downloads link, then choose the Windows binary release. Save the installer file to your computer. Once the download finishes, double‑click the file to launch the installer. Follow the prompts, accepting the default options, and let it copy the files. When the wizard reports completion, click Finish. Now we run the installer. Remember, installing Code::Blocks is just a download and run. Try installing Code::Blocks on your own computer.
